title: Wound-String Wooden Yo-Yo
description: One original static yo-yo gift: a single continuous solid wooden body with two rounded closed flanges and an integral narrow string waist, a real thin cord winding partly around the waist then extending to a separate closed finger loop. Three editable closed meshes and three opaque matte solid PBR roles. The flanges are solid, not deep open diabolo cups; the assembly is a single hand toy, not a yarn-spool tray, spinning top or detached industrial reel. All geometry newly authored on reused mesh/export tools. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal bounds centred; two finite faceted outer-rim bands rest at Z0. Small intentional buried cord/waist and cord/loop overlaps represent fixed display attachment. The raised cord is a posed static presentation, not gravity simulation. No animation, rotation, operating yo-yo, string unwinding, knot topology, acoustic, manufacture, safety, balance or stability claim. One whole prop, not separately counted parts.
